BEGIN;

DO $$
BEGIN
  CREATE TYPE lab_order_status AS ENUM (
    'requested', 'collected', 'processing', 'resulted',
    'cancelled', 'abnormal_flagged'
  );
EXCEPTION
  WHEN duplicate_object THEN NULL;
END $$;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lab_orders (
  id                    UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id               UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  subscription_id       UUID REFERENCES subscriptions (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  provider_id           UUID REFERENCES providers (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  status                lab_order_status NOT NULL DEFAULT 'requested',
  protocol_category     protocol_category,
  -- Panel: a free-form panel name from the catalog ("Lipid Panel",
  -- "CBC", "Comprehensive Metabolic Panel", "Testosterone Total"...).
  panel_name            TEXT NOT NULL,
  -- Patient-visible reason the provider ordered this panel. Non-PHI;
  -- short labels only.
  panel_reason          TEXT,
  -- Vendor wiring. Stub URL until Labcorp/Quest BAA is signed.
  vendor                TEXT,
  vendor_order_id       TEXT,
  vendor_requisition_url TEXT,
  -- Lifecycle timestamps.
  requested_at          TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  collected_at          TIMESTAMPTZ,
  resulted_at           TIMESTAMPTZ,
  -- Provider clinical note appended after results come back. PHI.
  provider_notes        TEXT,
  created_at            TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at            TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_lab_orders_user ON lab_orders (user_id, requested_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_lab_orders_status ON lab_orders (status);
CREATE TRIGGER trg_lab_orders_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON lab_orders
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lab_results (
  id            UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  lab_order_id  UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES lab_orders (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  -- One result row per analyte (e.g. LDL, HDL, Glucose).
  analyte_name  TEXT NOT NULL,
  value_text    TEXT NOT NULL,   -- "127", "Negative", "<0.5"
  unit          TEXT,            -- "mg/dL", "ng/mL", etc.
  reference_range TEXT,           -- "0-99"
  is_abnormal   BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  observed_at   TIMESTAMPTZ,
  created_at    TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_lab_results_order ON lab_results (lab_order_id);

COMMIT;
